name: Drandle Dreng (9-10) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Ring of Sustenance
items.description: This polished wooden ring constantly refreshes your body and mind. You don't need to eat or drink while wearing it, and you need only 2 hours of sleep per day to gain the benefits of 8 hours of sleep. A ring of sustenance doesn't function until it's been worn and invested continuously for a week. Removing it resets this interval.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: Drandle Dreng isn't Off-Guard to flanking, Hidden, or Undetected creatures of 10th-level or lower, or creatures of 10th-level or lower using surprise attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Evasion
defensiveAbilities.description: When Drandle Dreng rolls a success on a Reflex save, he get a critical success instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Sidestep
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The attack roll for a Strike targeting Drandle Dreng fails or critically fails

Effect Drandle Dreng redirects the attack to a creature of his choice that is adjacent to him and within the reach of the triggering attack. The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

defensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attack
defensiveAbilities.description: On the first round of combat, if Drandle Dreng rolls Deception or Stealth for initiative, creatures who haven't acted are Off-Guard to him.

offensiveAbilities.name: Debilitating Strike
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Drandle Dreng's Strike hits an Off-Guard creature and deals damage

Effect Drandle Dreng chooses one of the following debilitations for the target, which lasts until the end of his next turn:

  • it can't flank or contribute to allies' flanking,
  • it takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds,
  • or it becomes Enfeebled 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mobility
offensiveAbilities.description: When Drandle Dreng Strides half his Speed or less, that movement doesn't trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Skirmish Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: Drandle Dreng either Steps and then Strikes, or Strikes and then Steps.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Drandle Dreng deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tumble Behind
offensiveAbilities.description: When Drandle Dreng successfully Tumbles Through, the foe whose space he passed through is Off-Guard against the next attack he makes before the end of his turn.
